claims.claim: Self-employed people are not covered by the starter checklist.
claims.quote: Fill in this checklist if you’re an employee starting a new job without a P45
claims.note: The text says the checklist is for employees starting a new job, which implies self-employed work is not covered, but it never states that self-employed people are excluded.

claims.claim: Self-employed people are not subject to PAYE.
claims.quote: Self-employed workers are not paid through PAYE
claims.note: The text states self-employed workers are not paid through PAYE.
